title: Print 1 to N using recursion
intro: Recursion is induction in code: base case + smaller self-call. Always argue why the call stack shrinks.
intuition: Solve f(n) using f(smaller); write the base case that stops the chain.
approach: Call on strictly smaller instance; combine results.

cpp.notes: Replace the combine step to match “Print 1 to N using recursion”.

python.code:
def print_n(n: int) -> None:
    if n == 0: return
    print_n(n - 1)
    print(n, end=" ")
